description: This file defines a React component 'CodeButton' that manages the insertion and removal of 'code' blocks in a Slate.js rich text editor. It includes toolbar UI elements such as an icon, tooltip, and keyboard shortcut display, and handles wrapping and unwrapping nodes in the editor state.

methods.name: CodeButton
methods.description: React functional component that renders a toolbar button for toggling code blocks in a Slate editor, using state from useToolbarState, and applying transformations to the editor instance.
